XML Export Structure


Our XML export structure allows seamless integration with many Multiple Listing Services (MLS) and private website, ensuring your property data is accurately and efficiently shared across platforms. The export formats include all essential property details, such as listing information, images, pricing, and descriptions.

Please note: Adding this to your own website may require technical knowledge. PropertyList is unable to provide support for custom website integration.


For additional details or specific requirements, please raise a support ticket. Our team is here to assist you with any further information you may need.
